name: Bastian "Lucky" Vpy
arrive: Bastian "Lucky" Vpy walked back up the communication trench to R-F12, slower than before, but on his own feet. A letter from home reached Bastian "Lucky" Vpy before dusk. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy wrote down the news without trying to explain it. A border collie wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Bastian "Lucky" Vpy. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy gave it a name: Peg.
story: A border collie wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Bastian "Lucky" Vpy. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy gave it a name: Peg.

name: Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale
arrive: Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale returned to R-F20 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Orders assigned Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale to work as a sapper. The first lesson began with what not to touch. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale answered to number 306. Grey Mill is lost. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale found a muddy Airedale terrier shivering under a duckboard and shared his bread. Now the dog follows him everywhere. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale calls it Scout.
story: Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale found a muddy Airedale terrier shivering under a duckboard and shared his bread. Now the dog follows him everywhere. Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale calls it Scout.

name: Edmund Mcnamara
arrive: An officer asked who was writing the menus. Edmund Mcnamara admitted it and waited. The officer asked for a copy to send home. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Edmund Mcnamara is number 420. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Edmund Mcnamara helped stack spare sandbags at S-S7. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A Jack Russell terrier wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Edmund Mcnamara. Edmund Mcnamara gave it a name: Spot.
story: A Jack Russell terrier wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Edmund Mcnamara. Edmund Mcnamara gave it a name: Spot.

name: Bastian Wizzerd
arrive: Bastian Wizzerd measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together. A letter from home found Bastian Wizzerd before the night shift. Bastian Wizzerd folded it small and kept it close. The major nailed Bastian Wizzerd's posters to every dugout door and had the words read out at the dawn watch. From today Bastian Wizzerd is the Propagandist of the Concord. The rifle stays too. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Bastian Wizzerd is number 460. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Bastian Wizzerd kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. Bastian Wizzerd found a muddy Jack Russell terrier shivering under a duckboard and shared his bread. Now the dog follows him everywhere. Bastian Wizzerd calls it Socks.
story: Bastian Wizzerd found a muddy Jack Russell terrier shivering under a duckboard and shared his bread. Now the dog follows him everywhere. Bastian Wizzerd calls it Socks.

name: Walter Maccario
arrive: Walter Maccario of the Concord and Marek Seths of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Sorrow Copse now wait for it before they sleep. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The clerk counted the names twice. Walter Maccario is number 817 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Walter Maccario heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A Jack Russell terrier wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario gave it a name: Bess.
story: A Jack Russell terrier wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario gave it a name: Bess.

name: Anselm Rakan
arrive: Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Anselm Rakan went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home reached Anselm Rakan before dusk. Anselm Rakan read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Anselm Rakan answered to number 978. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R16. Anselm Rakan has learned to walk bent double. Anselm Rakan became a runner today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again. A German shepherd came up the line with the ration party and would not leave Anselm Rakan's side. Anselm Rakan named the dog Blue. The sergeant pretended not to see.
story: A German shepherd came up the line with the ration party and would not leave Anselm Rakan's side. Anselm Rakan named the dog Blue. The sergeant pretended not to see.

name: Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica
arrive: Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica read a theatre review while peeling supper. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. The quartermaster had a border collie pup nobody wanted. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica took it and called it Gyp. The whole squad already spoils it.

name: Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr
